items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Air Drop T1. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Headhunter. Ultimate (Air Drop) is available from Headhunter.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Cursed Relic later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Headshot heals pass down your tether to your mate.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,000 (levels 15-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kudzu Connection T3, Air Drop T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Stone Form, damage) grows from 85.1 to 121. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed, spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Entangling Thorns (2 to 3).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Entangling Thorns (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Stone Form: takes 18% off its 15s base cooldown.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-32,000 (levels 27-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Stone Form T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Stone Form, damage) grows from 121 to 287.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Air Drop: its duration-scaled parts (duration 21s, buff duration 8s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Sell Titanic Magazine for this, or Healbane if you took Rescue Beam.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 32,000-49,600 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Entangling Thorns T3.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Kudzu Connection: widens its range.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Air Drop on land damage radius (20m), Entangling Thorns radius (8m), Stone Form radius (5.8m). Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Air Drop duration (21s), Air Drop buff duration (8s), Air Drop debuff duration (3s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 3 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 147s; 20% off is 29.4s per full rotation.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.
sections.desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healbane.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts on you in the backline.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They keep diving you while Air Drop's on cooldown.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Air Drop deals damage (explode damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Cast it on the mate you're tethered to. Sell Healbane for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 147s of base cooldown across your kit, 100s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Siphon Bullets: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.
